outputs.gen-01-stationary: Month X, around the 4th; Saturn was above β Virginis, 1/2 cubit away, having moved 4 fingers back to the west, and was at its eastern stationary point.
outputs.gen-02-last-appearance: Month XI, the 18th; Mercury's last appearance in the west, in Pisces, not observed.
outputs.gen-03-lunar-eclipse: Night of the 14th, end of Libra, the moon was eclipsed at moonrise, 3 fingers in magnitude, to the east, 2 cubits behind α Librae. Jupiter in Gemini and Sirius were visible during the eclipse.
outputs.gen-04-acronychal-rising: Month X, the 14th; all day very overcast; acronychal rising of Sirius not observed.
